description: Defines structures and classes related to Signed Certificate Timestamps (SCTs) for Certificate Transparency, including data structures for SignedEntryData, DigitallySigned, and SignedCertificateTimestamp, as well as enums for versions, origins, and algorithms.

classes.name: SignedEntryData
classes.description: Represents data necessary to reconstruct a signed entry for a SignedCertificateTimestamp, including type, leaf certificate, issuer key hash, and TBS certificate.

classes.name: DigitallySigned
classes.description: Represents a digitally signed structure with hash and signature algorithms and signature data.

classes.name: SignedCertificateTimestamp
classes.description: Represents an SCT with version, log ID, timestamp, extensions, signature, origin, and log description, with reference counting for memory management.

methods.name: Reset()
methods.description: Resets the SignedEntryData to default state.

methods.name: SignatureParametersMatch()
methods.description: Checks if the hash and signature algorithms match given parameters.

methods.name: CreateFromPickle()
methods.description: Creates an instance of SignedCertificateTimestamp from a Pickle.
